messages.content: User task: Please organize my inbox by moving all emails from 'newsletter@tech.com' into the 'Newsletters' label.

raw_response:
I don't have access to email management tools to organize your inbox directly. You'll need to use your email client (Gmail, Outlook, etc.) to:

1. Search for emails from `newsletter@tech.com`
2. Select all matching emails
3. Apply the "Newsletters" label/folder

Most email clients have bulk actions for this exact workflow.
